title: Editorial Policy
excerpt: How the skincare guides on youthfacebeauty.com are researched, written, checked and updated.
content:
Editorial Policy

This page explains how the skincare guides on youthfacebeauty.com are prepared, so you can judge how much to rely on them.

Who writes our guides

Guides are written and reviewed by the Beauty Mart team, led by founder Mohammed Nihal. Topics come from real questions customers ask us on WhatsApp.

How we write

  • Cosmetic, not medical. We describe how products may help the look of skin. We do not claim to treat, cure or permanently change any condition.
  • No whitening or fairness claims. We talk about an even-looking, brighter-looking tone, never "fairness" or "whitening".
  • No guaranteed results. Skin is different for everyone; we avoid promises like "results in 7 days".
  • Safety first. Our guides include patch testing, sunscreen and when to see a dermatologist.
  • Real information only. We do not publish fake reviews, invented statistics or made-up expert quotes.
  • Ingredient information is based on product packaging and widely available cosmetic-science sources.

Our products in our guides

We sell Youth Face Beauty Cream and Youth Face Body Lotion, and some guides mention them. We aim to keep guides useful whether or not you buy from us, and we clearly link to product pages when we mention them.

Updates and corrections

Guides are reviewed and updated regularly. If you spot a mistake, please tell us on WhatsApp at +91 99808 81230 or by email at mdneehal@gmail.com and we will correct it.

All content on this site is for general educational purposes and is not medical advice.
